label_policy: Explicit cases state the intended boundary. Cases without the distinguishing fact are provisional routing leads and require clarification; they are not unconditional positive or negative truth labels.
routing_question: Is this a repeated run in the same setup, independent reconstruction, or bounds on service variation?
